title: Open Science Collaboration, “Estimating the reproducibility of psychological science”
summary: Peer-reviewed Science article reporting the Reproducibility Project: Psychology; used for the first replication-program record.

source_payload.host: Stanford-hosted author/institutional PDF mirror of Science article
source_payload.copyability: not embedded; DOI and mirror URL recorded
extraction_notes: Reports 100 replications of experimental/correlational studies from three psychology journals.
Reports replication effects about half the magnitude of original effects and several non-equivalent replication-success indicators.
Important caution: no single indicator is sufficient; the record preserves the plurality of metrics rather than one success/failure number.

handling_notes: Source is used for bounded claims only; do not inflate into total field consensus.
Where the source is a mirror, DOI/PubMed/official-anchor metadata must travel with it.
